powered_pullups.limit_basis: Shared maximum main-plus-postcursor current plus measured off-termination bias load scaled to target voltage, with 10% transient allowance. Must fit the shared total wired-TX current allocation; not achieved buffer capability.

alternating_postcursor_check.scope: Alternating-pattern negative-tap polarity check only; peak-to-peak values include ringing and are not an eye, arbitrary-data, or protocol-compliance result.

powered_pullups.control_scope: Explicit core sequencing: enable buffer at58ns before termination at60ns; disconnect termination at76ns before disabling buffer at78ns. Both source and sink turn off when unrequested. The 2ns lead/hold is a fixture scheduling assumption, not an implemented controller or a settled-loop guarantee.
limitations: Behavioral attached-core buffer only; output-stage and control circuitry are not laid out.

assumptions.postcursor_polarity: negative delayed tap; complementary gate controls reversed for POST

limitations: Grounded-gate drain-SAB devices are protection candidates, not a qualified ESD clamp.
Sense comparator uses the same PAD_P/N nodes; comparator and core DACs are external to this cell.
Source termination includes switched resistors and a passive TERM_VCM discharge resistor; impedance trim and the physical current-limited buffer remain unimplemented.
Detection enable has a local supply-powered buffer and passive discharge; reset and brownout supervision remain unimplemented.
Protection capacitance, cascode compliance and driver current must be measured, not assumed.
Behavioral mode/reset/supply guard is integrated; ideal core biases and prescribed qualification do not establish physical reset/brownout circuitry.
Detection lifecycle uses retained 3.3V pullups: no useful injection is expected above source compliance.
DC detection calibration at 0.4V is a separate load fixture, not the lifecycle load.
No package return coupling, statistical mismatch, noise, ESD or distributed wire resistance in this run.
Extracted capacitance replaces assigned metal C when a physical netlist is supplied; it is never added twice.

R/C common-mode probes have unlimited current. The separately identified bounded-buffer probe adds current/headroom limits and output-stage power accounting, not implemented regulation or reset/brownout controls.
